title: Bible Stories for Young Explorers
description: Compilation of Bible stories for young explorer 3-8 years old.

title: The Father Who Ran
description: A son goes far from home. His loving father runs to welcome him back.

title: When God Makes Everything New
description: John sees God's wonderful promise: a new heaven and earth, with no more tears or pain.

title: Where You Go, I Will Go
description: Ruth stays with Naomi, gathers grain, and receives kindness from Boaz.

title: Let the Children Come
description: Jesus welcomes the little children, holds them in his arms, and blesses them.

title: The Fourth Man in the Fire
description: Three men trust God. The king sees four men walking safely in the fire!

title: Hiding in the Garden
description: Adam and Eve eat the fruit God told them not to eat, then hide in the garden.

title: The King Who Kept the Wrong Promise
description: Herod makes a wrong promise. John speaks the truth, and his followers care for him after his death.

title: Help Me Believe!
description: Three disciples see Jesus on a mountain. A father asks for help, and Jesus lifts his boy by the hand.

title: Teach Us to Pray
description: Jesus teaches his disciples to pray and tells them about a friend asking for bread and a father giving good gifts.

title: Trusted, Framed, and Trusted Again
description: Joseph chooses to do right. Even when he is unfairly put in prison, God is with him.

title: The Rich Man Who Walked Away
description: A rich man asks Jesus about eternal life. Jesus loves him and invites him to follow.

title: Gideon and the Army That Was Too Big
description: God helps Gideon and three hundred men face a great army with trumpets, jars, and lights.

title: Pulled Out of Sodom
description: Two messengers lead Lot and his family out of Sodom. The Lord shows Lot mercy.
